description: MainActivity class for an Android app that displays a list of recipes and navigates to detailed recipe activities upon item selection.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity class providing a list interface for recipes, handling item clicks to navigate to recipe details.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles click events on list items; logs the click and starts the RecipeActivity with the selected recipe's name.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and binds the recipe list adapter.
